sharedDirection: Original exquisite old-school fantasy book illustration, expressive fine black ink contours and crosshatching with watercolor and gouache on aged paper. Muted verdigris, parchment ochre, deep midnight blue and amber highlights. Intricate hand-painted craftsmanship, sophisticated adult fantasy, no text, no logos, no borders, no 3D rendering, no pixel art. Landscape 3:2 composition, subject fully visible centered with generous room around it.

prompts.elian: A beautiful adult woman cartographer named Elian, about 30, luminous thoughtful hazel eyes, long wavy dark chestnut hair, warm olive skin, graceful strong features, quietly confident smile. Half-length portrait wearing an elegant deep teal embroidered traveling cloak over a cream linen blouse with a small brass moon clasp. She holds an unfurled parchment star chart and delicate brass compass. Moonlit willow woods and an old observatory softly behind her. Intelligent, capable, enchanting presence. Face centered in upper middle, hands and map visible below.
prompts.bridge: The broken crossing in a moonlit woodland: a narrow ancient mossy stone bridge over teal water with a missing wooden span. Five loose oak timbers rest on the near bank, alongside a coiled measuring cord and brass measuring instrument. Blue dusk and amber lantern light, beautifully drawn botanical details, a winding path toward an observatory. Main focus bridge and timbers, no people, no numerals.
prompts.cistern: An ancient observatory moonwater mechanism: a beautiful carved stone cistern filled with luminous silver teal water, four equal horizontal divisions etched subtly on its side, a brass pitcher on a stone ledge, delicate astrolabe gears and rings overhead. Moonlight falls through a Gothic window, moss and white night-blooming flowers curl around the stone. Magical and tangible, a still life of water and brass, no numerals.
prompts.guardian: An ancient majestic stone owl guardian in a ruined observatory chart chamber. Its broad sculpted wings unfurl, fine cracks glow with tiny amber and blue magical sparks, intelligent gentle eyes. An unfurled parchment star chart rests on a lectern below, brass celestial instruments and arched windows behind. Moonlit, mysterious and beautiful rather than frightening. Whole owl with wings visible, no people.
prompts.journal: An intimate fantasy still life on a carved oak desk: an open weathered leather wayfarer's journal filled with delicate unlettered constellation drawings, a brass compass, moonwater vial, feather quill, a small ornate clasp and rolled maps. Warm candlelight meets blue moonlight from a window overlooking the flooded woodland. Beautiful tactile paper and leather, no readable text.
prompts.preferences: A tranquil wayfarer’s outfitting alcove: a dark teal traveling cloak, adjustable brass lantern, spectacles and magnifying lenses, an hourglass on its side, herbs and traveling tools. Moonlit leaded windows, warm amber candlelight. Fine expressive ink and watercolor on aged paper, muted verdigris and midnight blue. No books, journals, star charts, maps, people, lettering, or interface.
